chapters.title: The suspended record
chapters.headline: A source-attributed credential passport for enrollment teams.
chapters.layout: Native-scroll cinematic stage, 44:56 desktop composition, 1200px width; viewport-height hero with 480px additional scroll runway.
chapters.trigger: Desktop width above 800px and height above 700px: progress across the sticky opening.
chapters.action: Approved raster dossier moves 22px left, 32px down, rotates −5 degrees and scales to 0.8. Source notes retreat; an opaque paper wipe reveals a real HTML passport summary. Original artwork fades only near the final phase. No status is approved by scrolling.
chapters.reverse: Every transform and the paper reveal reverse with scroll position. Returning to the top restores the exact untransformed artwork.
chapters.timing: Time-based 65ms damping; smoothstep phase mapping. Reveal spans progress 0.35–0.83. Rendering settles and stops when scrolling stops; hidden tabs stop animation.
chapters.mobile: Unpinned native document flow at width ≤800px or height ≤700px. Small image parallax, 33px mobile heading (31px at 320px), full source notes; real passport follows immediately.
chapters.reduced: Unpinned still hero; no decorative parallax, transform, or reveal; real passport remains fully operable.

chapters.title: A record you can read
chapters.headline: A clear record. An accountable next step.
chapters.layout: Immediately after the cinematic opening: filing tabs, olive bookcloth mount, paper workbench, three distinct status lanes.
chapters.trigger: Passport mount enters viewport; deliberate scenario and evidence selection controls the data.
chapters.action: Passport settles from a 55px rise, 5-degree perspective tilt and scale 0.975 to its final position. Three scenario tabs and provenance controls remain immediately usable.
chapters.reverse: Entrance follows viewport position in both directions. Scrolling never changes the selected scenario or its status.
chapters.timing: Scroll-mapped entrance over up to 520px; 65ms damping. Tab changes remain immediate.
chapters.mobile: Unpinned 18px entrance, scale 0.992–1, no tilt. Statuses stack; evidence table scrolls inside its container.
chapters.reduced: Complete interactive passport; no movement needed.

chapters.title: The work between the portals
chapters.headline: The record is scattered. The responsibility isn’t.
chapters.layout: Three editorial columns; 48px gutters; one two-sided before/after handoff.
chapters.trigger: Section enters the bottom 95% of viewport.
chapters.action: Heading and columns rise 12px into place. The comparison describes a proposed handoff; it never shows fabricated time saved.
chapters.timing: 700ms easing from kit; content never begins fully hidden.
chapters.mobile: Three stacked rows; before/after arrow becomes vertical.

chapters.title: Individual sources, one record
chapters.headline: The evidence comes together. The human stays in control.
chapters.layout: One sticky chapter: 155vh total; ≥1000px; stage top84px; up to820px tall.
chapters.trigger: Desktop native scroll across the chapter; skip link always available.
chapters.action: 0–33%: separated dossier. 34–66%: evidence attribution step. 67–100%: reviewer ownership. Three supplied vellum planes gather above the olive cover. Reading copy remains stationary.
chapters.reverse: Up-scroll separates the planes and restores the corresponding step. No unblocking or approval is represented by assembly.
chapters.timing: Spread maps 1→0.22 with normalized progress. Highlight changes at one-third boundaries.
chapters.mobile: No pinning at ≤800px or height≤650px. Show all three steps and a complete layered still.
chapters.reduced: No pinning; all steps fully opaque; spread0.45.

chapters.title: Five responsibilities
chapters.headline: Start with the dossier. Expand where the work leads.
chapters.layout: Five numbered full-width rows in original offer order; first module expanded.
chapters.trigger: Scroll arrival; click/tap/Enter on an offer row.
chapters.action: Each row reveals workflow, input/output, permission gate, and a concept-specific UI specimen. Report offers a clearly synthetic CSV.
chapters.reverse: Open modules remain open; anchors open their target module.
chapters.timing: 220ms surface/arrow feedback; native details expand without height trapping.
chapters.mobile: Name and description stack; full row is touch target; specimen follows copy.
chapters.reduced: All details remain operable; transitions removed.

chapters.title: The people accountable
chapters.headline: Operations sees the whole file. Specialists own the work.
chapters.layout: Three editorial audience columns with matching baseline and direct audit links.
chapters.action: A restrained12px entrance introduces MSOs, delegated organizations, and consultancies. Buyer/operator split is explicit.
chapters.reverse: One-time entrance; no repeated hover-only information.
chapters.reduced: All text and CTAs immediately visible.

chapters.title: Fit before replacement
chapters.headline: Your current workflow is the starting point.
chapters.layout: Three comparison rows; category / role / access caveat.
chapters.action: No moving vendor logos or connection lines. Explain incumbent overlap and access uncertainty with text.
chapters.mobile: Stack each comparison row; labels remain attached.

chapters.title: Permission is part of the product
chapters.headline: When the answer is uncertain, the record should say so.
chapters.layout: Editorial left column with supplied brass clip; right column of four accountable boundaries.
chapters.action: Subtle list entrance. All boundaries stay readable: consent, source standards, terms/oversight, synthetic-only scope.
chapters.timing: 700ms from the kit. Clip is still; no speculative 3D rotation.
chapters.mobile: Clip hidden as decorative; four rows stack without losing content.

chapters.title: Evidence before expansion
chapters.headline: Begin with a dossier-rework audit. Earn the right to build.
chapters.layout: Readiness criteria strip; metric and hypothetical-price columns; stop rule at full width.
chapters.action: Gate values appear at their final values. No animated counters. Price label and non-achieved milestones remain visible.
chapters.reverse: Stable final values; no performance inference.
chapters.mobile: 2×2 gate grid, then stacked metric, price, stop rule.

chapters.title: Why ClinicianFile
chapters.headline: Build an accountable operating layer.
chapters.layout: Two-column editorial statement; no fabricated team portraits or customer badges.
chapters.action: State vision, initial mission, expansion hypothesis and unverified commercial status.

chapters.title: Important distinctions
chapters.headline: Clear before the first conversation.
chapters.layout: Editorial title beside six disclosure questions.
chapters.action: Reveal focused answers on concept stage, distinct workflows, access, pilot, human actions, and permitted inquiry data.
chapters.reverse: Open answer remains open; no scroll-triggered collapse.
chapters.mobile: Single column, full question touch targets.

chapters.title: Start with the work
chapters.headline: Find the rework in your next handoff.
chapters.layout: Scope explanation beside quiet paper form; official references and complete footer follow.
chapters.trigger: CTA anchor or natural scroll; deliberate local form validation.
chapters.action: Error messages name missing fields. A valid synthetic entry produces explicit local-only feedback. No sending, analytics, storage, booking, or payment.
chapters.reverse: Entered values stay only in the current page until refresh; scroll has no effect.
chapters.timing: Immediate validation; visible focus ring; controls140–220ms.
